description: Exact non-text visual-layer opacity exceptions plus per-file/token ratcheting ceilings for reviewed legacy text-ink opacity utilities. Exceptions are not palette approvals. Ceilings may decrease but must never increase; any new file/token pair is rejected, and important booking, financial, security, policy, and operational contexts are rejected independently.

exceptions.reason: The image action overlay remains fully visible on touch viewports and is visually hidden only until hover or focus-within on pointer layouts.
The opacity applies only to a blurred decorative image used behind the readable foreground artwork and never to text or controls.
The opacity applies to a non-content background image layer beneath an independent opaque readability scrim and semantic foreground copy.
